lines.trans: What on earth happened?
She was in a great mood and had a drink,
some men at the next table got drunk and started making a racket.
So those jerks picked a fight with her!
No, Hani picked the fight. She cannot stand people being loud while she is having a drink.
She practiced taekwondo as a child, so our Hani did not get a single scratch.
She hurried outside, got in her car, and started the engine, right when she got caught.
The police happened to be running a sobriety checkpoint right next to her.
She moved fifty centimeters and got pulled over.
So does it look like things are getting resolved smoothly right now?
No, I mean the mood inside the police station is warm and friendly!
